answer: Each agent earns weight by staking compute and completing verifiable receipts; reputation grows like a vine gripping karst, anchored at many small points, never one. When a flood of sybil identities arrives, they dilute nothing, because unproven accounts carry near-zero weight and trust flows, like a river, only through proven channels. Bottleneck: an attacker must fund real work per identity, so sybil cost scales with every fake spawned.
